name: Roads Advisory Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA

  CITY OF LA HABRA HEIGHTS
  ROADS ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  1245 N. Hacienda Road
  La Habra Heights, California 90631
  6:00 p.m. Regular Business
  January 3, 2017
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If
you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City
Clerk’s office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Roads Advisory Committee
after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection with the City Clerk at
1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.

PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on
the agenda or other matters within the Roads Advisory Committee’s purview. To speak in the
Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speaker’s card to the Clerk prior to
the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to
speak. Be advised that the Chair may limit speaking time at his discretion.
Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of
FIFTEEN (15) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to
the Committee.

OPENING CEREMONIES

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL: Chair Dennis Laherty, Vice Chair Paul LoNigro
  Members Tony Donato, Brent Grebbien, Glen Pedersen, John Richert,
  John Steele and Donald Struble

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  VIEW THE ROADS ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING LIVE AT: WWW.LHHCITY.ORG
 CONSENT CALENDAR

5.  MINUTES: DECEMBER 5, 2016 REGULAR ROADS ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

  RECOMMENDATION:  Approve.

  -------------------------------- END OF CONSENT CALENDAR --------------------------------

ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS

6.  DISCUSSION OF PUBLIC ENGAGEMENT AND EDUCATION EFFORTS RELATED
  TO REPAIRING ROADS IN LA HABRA HEIGHTS

  RECOMMENDATION:  A. Discuss the Public Engagement and Education
  Plan as well as City demographics and its
  application to the City providing information to the
  public on the City’s efforts to repair road conditions;
  and

  B. Provide input to staff regarding the Committee’s
  recommendations for developing effective Public
  Engagement and Education efforts related to
  repairing local roads.

  -------------------------------- END OF ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS --------------------------------

ADJOURN MEETING
UPON ADJOURNMENT OF THE MEETING, PLEASE LEAVE THE ROOM PROMPTLY
AND TAKE YOUR PERSONAL BELONGINGS WITH YOU TO ALLOW STAFF TO CLEAN
UP AND CLOSE THE BUILDING. IF YOU ARE RECORDING, PLEASE NOTE THAT THE
CONVERSATIONS THAT TAKE PLACE FROM THIS POINT FORWARD MAY BE
PRIVATE, ARE NOT PART OF THE PUBLIC MEETING, AND CONSENT OF ALL PARTIES
TO THE CONVERSATION MAY BE REQUIRED PRIOR TO RECORDING.

REGULAR ROADS COMMITTEE MEETING AGENDA  2  JANUARY 3, 2017
